title: Daily cost import: Cost Explorer by anthus: tags from the management account, shared-cost split, cost tag activation as code
description: docs/COST_ACCOUNTING.md, 'Where costs come from'. A scheduled job in (or with a role from) the Organizations management account queries yesterday's cost grouped by anthus:account, anthus:app, anthus:deployment and service; splits app 'shared' costs by reported usage; records unattributed overhead; charges the quota week. A stack activates the cost allocation tags via UpdateCostAllocationTagsStatus. Needs the owner: which account is the management account, and the new role.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Built in AnthusAI/Prospectus#144 and tested against a fake Cost Explorer. Behind the costImport flag, committed off. The management account is the 'management' profile, found 2026-11-09; the runtime discovers it with DescribeOrganization, so no ID is committed. Not deployed: needs Ryan's approval for the management-account role stack and the runtime's AssumeRole permission. Tag activation waits until an app's tagged resources have been billed. Monthly charges are not yet spread over the month.

comments.author: home
comments.text: 2026-11-09: deployed ProspectusCostManagement in the management account with Ryan's approval. It is one role, prospectus-cost-import: read-only ce:GetCostAndUsage, trusted only by prospectus-central-accounts-runtime. Tags are not activated yet because AWS needs them on billed usage first. The import's query ran once by hand for 2026-11-07 and returned 27 groups, all untagged so far. On the same day Ryan approved turning on costImport and usageQueues in develop.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Live in production 2026-11-09 (#146). A manual run of the import assumed prospectus-cost-import, queried Nov 6–8 and recorded 21 overhead lines per day, with no actuals because nothing is tagged yet. The 07:15 UTC schedule is enabled. Left: activate the cost tags after the first app's tagged resources are billed, and spread monthly charges over their month.
